She speaks enthusiastically toward the camera, gesturing widely with both hands. The walls are decorated with framed posters of classical music performers. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room where the woman sits beside a large black grand piano. She is interviewing a bearded man in a dark suit and a patterned blue shirt. The man smiles and speaks, while a small microphone is clipped to his piano. Variety-style text graphics and symbols flash on screen. (3) The man is shown in various close-up and medium shots playing the grand piano with intense focus. His fingers move rapidly across the keys. Semi-transparent overlays of the woman's reacting face appear periodically over the footage of him playing.
